activities.name: ForEach1
activities.description: Loops through each configured EMR table, checks for existing files, archives when required, and performs either a full or incremental load.

activities.name: File_Exists
activities.description: Checks if the target file exists in the Bronze layer.

activities.name: If Condition2
activities.description: Checks if the Bronze file exists and uses its last modified date to archive only files that existed before the current pipeline run.

activities.name: If Condition1
activities.description: Checks the configured load type and routes the table to either the Full Load or Incremental Load process.

query.value: @concat('select coalesce(cast(max(loaddate) as date),''','1900-01-01',''') as last_fetched_date from project_dev.audit.load_logs where',' data_source=''',item().datasource,''' and tablename=''',item().tablename,'''')
